tenderSchedule.title: RFP FOR SUPPLY, INSTALLATION, COMMISSIONING AND CONFIGURATION OF 24 RACK SERVERS FOR KSDC WITH 5 YEARS WARRANTY AND SUPPORT
tenderSchedule.description: RFP FOR SUPPLY, INSTALLATION, COMMISSIONING AND CONFIGURATION OF 24 RACK SERVERS FOR KSDC WITH 5 YEARS WARRANTY AND SUPPORT

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Room no 252, 2nd floor, MS building, gate no 2, Bengaluru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have executed single order of Rs 27 crores/ Two order of Rs 13.5 crores each/ Three order of Rs 9 crores each / Four order of Rs 6.75 crores each for Supply of IT equipment like servers/storage/network devices during last 7 years as on bid submission date to any SDC/State Govt Department/GOI Department/Central or State PSU/ Enterprise.
Bidder should have valid ISO 9001 and 27001 OR 20000.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the valid ISO certificates.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must be a company registered in India under companies Act/Limited Liability partnership act and should have been in operation for a period of at least 5 years as on bid date. (Consortium formed for the purpose of this project are not eligible to bid for this project. Trusts and societies are also not eligible to bid for this project)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Partnership

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The average annual turnover of the Bidder during the last 3 financial years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) shall not be less than Rs.50 Cr (Fifty crores)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have a positive net worth for the last 3 financial Years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should not have filed for bankruptcy

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Declaration in this regard by the authorized signatory of the bidder should be attached.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have at least one permanent/working office in Bengaluru.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-Certificate issued by the HR head/Authorized signatory of the bidder organization.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not have been blacklisted by the Government of India or any state government or any of its agencies for any reasons whatsoever and the bidder should not have been blacklisted by Central / any other State/UT Government or its agencies for indulging in corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices as on last date of bidding for this tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking from the Company Secretary or the Authorized Signatory.
